Coordination/Ed25519 Public Key.description: Canonical lowercase hex encoding of 32 Ed25519 public-key bytes.
Coordination/Ed25519 Public Key.name: Ed25519 Public Key

Coordination/Ed25519 Signature.description: Canonical lowercase hex encoding of 64 pure Ed25519 signature bytes.
Coordination/Ed25519 Signature.name: Ed25519 Signature

Coordination/Timeline Provider.description: Identifies a timeline provider, its verification key and the common HTTPS API serving all of its public and private timelines. Domain subtypes can supply company details and an inherited endpoint.

endpoint.description: Base HTTPS URL of this provider’s REST API, without a trailing slash. Append /timelines/read to fetch entries and completeness for any of its timelines; append /provider for discovery and /access/create, /access/update or /access/get for Timeline Access. The SAME endpoint serves public and private timelines: public reads accept bare requests, while private reads require an authorized Ed25519 Signed Reader Request. All read responses are provider-signed. This value may be inherited from the provider type; individual timelines do not override it.

Coordination/Timeline Provider.name: Timeline Provider

Coordination/Timeline.description: An immutable publication history identified by its exact provider and canonical HTTPS resource URL.
Coordination/Timeline.name: Timeline

Coordination/Provider Descriptor.description: Signed discovery data; endpoint changes cannot replace adopted identity.
Coordination/Provider Descriptor.name: Provider Descriptor

operations.description: Exact operation type BlueIds advertised as text; not version labels or request instances.

Coordination/Actor.description: An identified entity to which a timeline occurrence is attributed. Domain types define its identity details.
Coordination/Actor.name: Actor

Coordination/Principal Actor.description: A human actor. Extend this type with the identifying details appropriate to the domain.
Coordination/Principal Actor.name: Principal Actor

Coordination/Agent Actor.description: A non-human actor, such as an application, automated service or institution. Domain types define its details.
Coordination/Agent Actor.name: Agent Actor

context.description: Exact submission context. Optional; presence and exact type are checked by the protocol verifier.

Coordination/Source.description: Authenticated submission provenance, not a provider URL.
Coordination/Source.name: Source

Coordination/Timeline Entry.description: An immutable occurrence attributed to an Actor. At most one entry per microsecond on this timeline; prevEntry names its immediate predecessor.

message.description: Required exact original message; presence is validated even for an unvalued Blue definition.

Coordination/Timeline Entry.name: Timeline Entry

operation.description: Exact Contracts/Operation Request, equal to message when recognized. Optional; presence and exact type are checked by the protocol verifier.

prevEntry.description: Reference to Timeline Entry; absent only at genesis. Optional; presence and exact type are checked by the protocol verifier.

source.description: Source value authenticated by the provider. Optional; presence and exact type are checked by the protocol verifier.

Coordination/Provider Attestation.description: Domain-separated provider signature of accepted protocol content.
Coordination/Provider Attestation.name: Provider Attestation

object.description: Required exact object. Allowed object types and provider binding are checked by the protocol.

Coordination/Timeline Completeness Guara.description: No future acceptance below exclusive completeBefore; lastEntry is inside that prefix.

lastEntry.description: Reference to last Timeline Entry inside the closed prefix; absent for empty prefix. Optional; presence and exact type are checked by the protocol verifier.

Coordination/Timeline Completeness Guara.name: Timeline Completeness Guarantee

Coordination/Timeline Attestation.description: Signature of the exact guarantee under the dedicated guarantee domain.
Coordination/Timeline Attestation.name: Timeline Attestation

after.description: Previously established Timeline Entry anchor. Optional; presence and exact type are checked by the protocol verifier.

Coordination/Timeline Range Evidence.description: Assembled contiguous range through the attested prefix head, not a physical page.
Coordination/Timeline Range Evidence.name: Timeline Range Evidence

after.description: Previously established Timeline Entry anchor. Optional; presence and exact type are checked by the protocol verifier.

Coordination/Timeline Successor Evidence.description: Authenticated accepted successor proves the prefix strictly before its timestamp.
Coordination/Timeline Successor Evidence.name: Timeline Successor Evidence

Coordination/Provider Request.description: Base API request. Concrete operations carry their own parameters; no common client ID, clock, nonce or repeated provider is required.
Coordination/Provider Request.name: Provider Request

Coordination/Signed Reader Request.description: Reader proof over exact request content. Does not grant owner authority.
Coordination/Signed Reader Request.name: Signed Reader Request

Coordination/Provider Response.description: Response correlated through an exact Blue reference to its request. The outer attestation identifies the provider.
Coordination/Provider Response.name: Provider Response

Coordination/Provider Failure.description: Typed error; never a proof of absent entries or revoked access.

detail.description: Text safe diagnostic. Optional; presence and exact type are checked by the protocol verifier.

Coordination/Provider Failure.name: Provider Failure

Coordination/Create Timeline Request.description: Optional owner-ingest extension. Create a source owned by the authenticated account.
Coordination/Create Timeline Request.name: Create Timeline Request

Coordination/Timeline Created Response.description: Optional owner-ingest extension. The exact durable created source.
Coordination/Timeline Created Response.name: Timeline Created Response

Coordination/Append Entry Request.description: Optional owner-ingest extension. Owner-only submission of the original message.

expectedLastEntry.description: Expected Timeline Entry head. Optional; presence and exact type are checked by the protocol verifier.

message.description: Required exact original message, resolved and validated by the provider.

Coordination/Append Entry Request.name: Append Entry Request

Coordination/Append Entry Response.description: Optional owner-ingest extension. Durable accepted result and its reusable provider evidence.
Coordination/Append Entry Response.name: Append Entry Response

afterEntry.description: Exact Timeline Entry anchor. Optional; presence and exact type are checked by the protocol verifier.

afterTimestamp.description: Integer exclusive lower timestamp, >= -1. Mutually exclusive with afterEntry. Optional; presence and exact type are checked by the protocol verifier.

Coordination/Timeline Read Cursor.description: Immutable checkpoint-bound continuation. Access is rechecked for every use.
Coordination/Timeline Read Cursor.name: Timeline Read Cursor

afterEntry.description: Timeline Entry anchor. Optional; presence and exact type are checked by the protocol verifier.

afterTimestamp.description: Integer exclusive lower timestamp, >= -1. Optional; presence and exact type are checked by the protocol verifier.

cursor.description: Timeline Read Cursor. At most one of the three selectors is present. Optional; presence and exact type are checked by the protocol verifier.

Coordination/Read Timeline Request.description: Read a closed timeline prefix: positive limit for a page plus checkpoint; zero for checkpoint only.

minimumCompleteBefore.description: Optional Integer exclusive minimum bound for a fresh read. Forbidden with cursor; provider returns BOUND_UNAVAILABLE when it cannot meet it.

Coordination/Read Timeline Request.name: Read Timeline Request

Coordination/Timeline Entries Page.description: A page within a permanently sealed prefix. hasMore=false exhausts the selected suffix before checkpoint.completeBefore; no later entry can be inserted there.
Coordination/Timeline Entries Page.name: Timeline Entries Page

nextCursor.description: Timeline Read Cursor; present exactly when hasMore is true. Optional; presence and exact type are checked by the protocol verifier.

predecessor.description: Immediate Timeline Entry before returned suffix. Optional; presence and exact type are checked by the protocol verifier.

Coordination/Timeline Read Response.description: Request-correlated signed checkpoint and, exactly when requested, a bulk page from that same prefix.
Coordination/Timeline Read Response.name: Timeline Read Response

page.description: Timeline Entries Page required exactly when request.limit > 0; absent for limit=0. Its checkpoint must equal the response checkpoint.

Coordination/Fetch Timeline Entry Reques.description: Exact-entry read subject to current read access.
Coordination/Fetch Timeline Entry Reques.name: Fetch Timeline Entry Request

Coordination/Timeline Entry Response.description: Exact retrieved entry and reusable acceptance attestation.
Coordination/Timeline Entry Response.name: Timeline Entry Response

content.description: Exact Blue reference to the content.

Coordination/Resolve Timeline Content Re.description: Resolve exact reachable content under timeline-scoped authorization.
Coordination/Resolve Timeline Content Re.name: Resolve Timeline Content Request

content.description: Required exact content matching the requested content reference.

Coordination/Timeline Content Response.description: Exact verified content at the requested BlueId.
Coordination/Timeline Content Response.name: Timeline Content Response

Coordination/Public Timeline Channel.description: Authenticated input from the public Signed Timeline identified by provider and url. Read its entries through the provider endpoint without reader credentials.
Coordination/Public Timeline Channel.name: Public Timeline Channel

Coordination/Timeline Access Update.description: Complete replacement of both permission sets. Each listed key may read each listed timeline.
Coordination/Timeline Access Update.name: Timeline Access Update

Coordination/Update Timeline Access.description: Provider-channel operation validating and atomically replacing both access sets, then emitting one Timeline Access Updated event, including unchanged-list updates. Invalid or rolled-back updates emit no committed event; consumed requests do not execute again. Distinct requests have distinct occurrences. The event is a notification; verified history and executed state remain the authority.
Coordination/Update Timeline Access.name: Update Timeline Access

Coordination/Timeline Access.description: Executable Blue permission document. Its provider public channel authorizes an atomic replacement of the timeline and key sets.
Coordination/Timeline Access.name: Timeline Access

Coordination/Timeline Access Response.description: Original access document, current executed document, public publication proof and latest relevant entry. Freshness requires complete public history.
Coordination/Timeline Access Response.name: Timeline Access Response

Coordination/Timeline Update Stream.description: Optional generation-specific batch feed using an ordinary public timeline.
Coordination/Timeline Update Stream.name: Timeline Update Stream

Coordination/Timeline Stream Binding.description: Provider-attested immutable interval mapping, available to authorized readers.
Coordination/Timeline Stream Binding.name: Timeline Stream Binding

Coordination/Timeline Announcement.description: Salted commitment to one accepted entry; no private content or salt is published.
Coordination/Timeline Announcement.name: Timeline Announcement

Coordination/Timeline Stream Batch.description: Complete announcements for the stream-bound sources in [fromInclusive, completeBefore).
Coordination/Timeline Stream Batch.name: Timeline Stream Batch

Coordination/Get Stream Binding Request.description: Read stream assignment for one timeline and timestamp.
Coordination/Get Stream Binding Request.name: Get Stream Binding Request

Coordination/Stream Binding Response.description: Authenticated immutable assignment; absence is not completeness.
Coordination/Stream Binding Response.name: Stream Binding Response

Coordination/Fetch Stream Entry Request.description: Authorized opening of one announcement by exact feed entry and row.
Coordination/Fetch Stream Entry Request.name: Fetch Stream Entry Request

Coordination/Stream Entry Response.description: Exact data entry and private salt opening a batch commitment.
Coordination/Stream Entry Response.name: Stream Entry Response

afterBatch.description: Previously established batch Timeline Entry anchor. Optional; presence and exact type are checked by the protocol verifier.

Coordination/Timeline Stream Evidence.description: Contiguous full batches under an authenticated assignment, not filtered inclusions.
Coordination/Timeline Stream Evidence.name: Timeline Stream Evidence

Coordination/Order Key.description: Canonical order across timelines; identifiers compare as ASCII bytes.
Coordination/Order Key.name: Order Key

Coordination/Source Coverage.description: Verifier-established source frontier and evidence; not a caller claim of readiness.

evidence.description: Required exact Timeline Range Evidence, Timeline Successor Evidence or Timeline Stream Evidence.

lastEntry.description: Exact Timeline Entry at the established prefix head. Optional; presence and exact type are checked by the protocol verifier.

Coordination/Source Coverage.name: Source Coverage

Coordination/Input Selection.description: Evidence-bearing selection description for a Contracts adapter, not an execution proof.
Coordination/Input Selection.name: Input Selection

Coordination/Timeline Channel.description: Direct authenticated actor input on a declared timeline. Implementation requires this exact protocol.
Coordination/Timeline Channel.name: Timeline Channel

Coordination/Timeline Access Updated.name: Timeline Access Updated
Coordination/Timeline Access Updated.description: A Timeline Access update operation completed successfully. Consumers read the completed access document for current permissions.
